title: activitypub/inbox.rs: inbox_url conditional is always identical
description:
Why this issue exists: In crates/mail/src/activitypub/inbox.rs, handle_follow computes inbox_url inside a conditional where both branches produce format!('{}/inbox', actor_url). The branching is dead — both arms emit the same string — making the intent opaque and the code misleading.

What needs to be done: Remove the conditional and compute inbox_url unconditionally once before its use.
